mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0% in the past month, it signals weakening labor market conditions that may lead to economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS does not produce negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 110.0), the economy is in an expansionary phase, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 60% of instances when INDPRO > 110.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 3.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising PAYEMS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals aggressive monetary tightening in response to high inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not produce negative 5d returns in > 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0 over any 3-year rolling window.
